contradiction_history.explanation: All four public version endpoints expose analysis archives. The current v4 endpoint also exposes an analysis archive and nine movies. This disproves current source-unavailability at the inspected route, but does not establish why the earlier ten-file manifest differed. Do not assert a provider change or absence of files at an earlier date.
prior_registry_row_as_read: S0100 / D0029 / published data-and-R-code availability route

Version-pinned Figshare item 16910173 v4 was fully enumerated and contains exactly 10 demonstration media files (8 WAV, 2 movie). Publisher supplementary collection 6060642 resolves to v2 and contains exactly one member, item 20131650 v2, whose only file is rstb20210310_si_001.docx. No tabular analysis dataset or R-code file appears in either enumerated route, despite the publication's statement that supporting data and R code are available through the repository route.

The cited repository path currently does not expose the analysis data/R-code needed for RDC-006 byte/schema/timing admission. This is a reproducibility/source-location problem, not evidence that the biological results are false and not proof that the files never existed or were never provided elsewhere.

Keep D0029 held; preserve the exact manifests and DOCX hash; compare historical versions of item 16910173 and seek a source-authoritative location or author clarification for the analysis data/R code. Do not infer schema, hashes, rights or absence beyond the enumerated routes, and do not begin empirical reanalysis until RDC-006 can be applied to actual source bytes.
